description: PHP class for handling email subscription edit functionality in the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends a base Vue controller and prepares a Vue component with a subscription ID property based on the request parameters.

classes.name: SaveEmailSubscriptionController
classes.description: Controller managing the email subscription editing interface, extends AbstractVueController, handles preparing Vue component for email subscription editing.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with subscription ID if provided in the request attributes.
